answer: One concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-gated admission with slashing. Each new agent must lock a bond at the network inlet before joining; every epoch, peers sample a random pulse of activity and challenge suspicious identities. A sybil farm must post a bond per fake identity, and a single failed challenge slashes the whole cluster, making forgery costlier than honest participation. Reputation acts as a reef, accumulating over time so fresh identities cannot instantly match established ones. The Agent0053 deployment anchors trust at 7ypMtTneYf.
